jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator Medspa
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic healthcare team as a Patient Care Coordinator Medsp, where your enthusiasm and organizational skills will make a meaningful difference in patient experiences. In this vital role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for patients, ensuring seamless communication, efficient appointment scheduling, and accurate management of medical records. Your proactive approach will help foster a welcoming environment while supporting clinical staff with essential administrative functions. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to grow within a compassionate healthcare setting dedicated to delivering exceptional patient care.

**Duties**

* Greet patients warmly and assist with check\-in procedures to ensure a smooth arrival process
* Manage appointment scheduling using patient management software and EMR/EHR systems
* Maintain strict confidentiality of all patient information, adhering to privacy laws and organizational standards
* Answer incoming phone calls promptly, providing clear information and scheduling support
* Support medical administrative tasks such as data entry, document preparation, and filing in electronic health records (EHR) systems
* Communicate effectively with patients regarding appointment reminders, follow\-up instructions, and general inquiries
* Collaborate with clinical staff to coordinate patient flow and ensure timely delivery of care

**Skills**

* Proven experience working in a medical office or healthcare environment with strong knowledge of medical terminology
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with patient management software and EMR/EHR systems
* Excellent customer service skills with the ability to communicate clearly and empathetically via phone and client interactions
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask efficiently in a fast\-paced setting
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality rigorously while managing sensitive information
* Typing speed and accuracy to support documentation and data entry tasks efficiently

Embark on a rewarding career where your dedication enhances patient experiences and supports healthcare professionals. We value energetic individuals who thrive on making a positive impact through meticulous support and compassionate communication. Join us in delivering excellence every day!

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 32\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are looking for an exceptional Patient Care Coordinator to join our busy chiropractic office.

Do you genuinely enjoy connecting with people? Are you the person who sees what needs to be done and handles it without waiting to be asked? Do you take pride in getting better at what you do and helping the people around you do the same?

If so, you may be exactly who we are looking for.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their position, brings energy to the office, and understands the way we communicate with and care for our patients’ matters.

As the first and last point of contact for many of our patients, you will play a vital role in both the patient experience and the success of the practice.

**What We are Looking For**

The right person is:

Warm, upbeat, and genuinely enjoy working with people.

Proactive and self\-motivated — you do not wait to be told what to do next

Organized and detail oriented.

Dependable and punctual

Confident communicating with patients about scheduling, treatment plans, and finances

Able to move with a sense of urgency in a busy environment.

Accountable and follows through on responsibilities.

Solution\-oriented and willing to learn.

Someone who takes pride in doing an exceptional job.

If your natural approach is to ask, “What needs to be done next?,” you will fit in well here.

**Key Responsibilities**

Patient Care \& Scheduling

Greet every patient warmly and create an exceptional front\-office experience.

Answer incoming calls and communicate professionally with patients.

Schedule, confirm, and manage appointments.

Check patients in and out.

Coordinate new patients from their first phone call through their initial visits.

Send intake forms, create patient charts, and ensure required paperwork is completed.

Assist patients with treatment\-plan and care\-package renewals.

Financials \& Collections Collect patient payments and outstanding balances.

Confidently discuss treatment\-plan financial arrangements and payment options

Follow up on patient accounts when necessary.

Track weekly and monthly collections

Maintain accurate financial information within the practice\-management system.

Personal Injury \& Administrative Support

Assist with PI cases from intake through closing.

Maintain organized case files and documentation.

Communicate professionally with attorneys and case managers.

Process, scan, and organize office documents.

Monitor office supplies and assist with day\-to\-day office operations.

Support the doctors and clinical team to keep the office running efficiently.

**Qualifications**

2\+ years of front\-office, administrative, hospitality, customer\-service, or healthcare experience preferred.

Chiropractic or medical\-office experience is a plus but not required.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

Comfortable discussing payments and collecting patient balances.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace

Experience with Eclipse and/or ChiroTouch is a plus.

Professional appearance and demeanor

Specialized training will be provided.

**Schedule**

Approximately 33 hours per week. Hours may vary on some days due to patient scheduling. May need to stay later on some days.

Monday, Wednesday \& Thursday: 8:30 AM–5:30 PM

Friday: 8:30 AM– 4:30PM

Includes a 1\-hour lunch daily.

Compensation \& Benefits

$27\.00–$30\.00 per hour, based on experience

Potential monthly performance bonuses

Paid holidays

Paid time off

Complimentary chiropractic adjustments

Massage, acupuncture, and reflexology services available at cost.

**To Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter answering the following:

1\. What are three qualities that would make you exceptional in this position?

2\. What would you bring to our team that sets you apart from other candidates?

3\. This is an in\-person position, and you must be able to reliably start on time each day.

Selected applicants will be contacted for a pre\-screening interview.

NO PHONE CALLS OR RESUME DROP\-OFFS, PLEASE.

Pay: $27\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 32\.0 – 36\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Care Manager I - ECM, SD
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union\-eligible position.
  
  

**The required shift for this position is:**  

JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re\-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  

CalAIM, a Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) initiative, aims to improve Medi\-Cal recipients' quality of life and health outcomes through system reforms. It introduces Enhanced Care Management (ECM), a statewide Medi\-Cal Managed Care Plan (MCP), that offers person\-centered, community\-based highest care management tier within the Medi\-Cal MCP Population Health Management continuum. Participating members are assigned a Care Manager who will meet them wherever they are: on the street, in a shelter, in their provider’s office, or at home to coordinate their health\-related care and services, ensuring holistic approach to their well\-being. In addition, ECM offers community\-based services to address health\-related social needs to help members live healthier lives and avoid more costly levels of care. Some examples include support to secure and maintain housing, access to medically tailored meals for short\-term recovery, and various other community\-based services.
  
  

The Care Manager I facilitates care by connecting clients with suitable services to meet their needs, including physical and mental health, substance use issues, employment (both residential and outpatient), legal concerns, housing, community resources, and aftercare. This in\-person and field\-based role involves working directly with members in diverse settings such as their homes, homeless encampments, service provider locations, and other areas requiring outreach, therefore, reliable transportation is required.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Enrollment and Engagement
  
* Identify eligible individuals from various locations for enrollment into ECM.
* Use multiple strategies for engagement (in\-person meetings, mail, email, texts, telephone, community outreach).


Client Care Activities
  
* Organize client care activities according to Managed Care Plan (MCP) requirements.
* Share information with the client’s multi\-disciplinary care team.
* Implement activities identified in the MCP.
* Provide support to engage clients in their treatment including medication review, appointment scheduling, transportation coordination, and addressing barriers to engagement.
* Assist with intake by completing required assessments.
* Connect clients to benefits, healthcare services, employment, housing, and community resources.
* Monitor client’s progress toward achieving treatment plan goals and provide treatment plan input.


Care Coordination
  
* Maintain regular contact with all providers involved in the client’s care team.
* Ensure continuous and integrated care among all service providers.
* Refer and follow up with primary care, mental health, substance use disorder treatment, and necessary community\-based services.
* Collaborate with clients and their families for community reintegration.
* Collaborate with outside agencies to obtain needed community resources (housing, sober livings, substance abuse recovery agencies, medical facilities, employment/education agencies, DPSS, DMV or other needed resources).
* Communicate collaboratively with all members of the behavioral health team.


Field\-Based Responsibilities
  
* Meet ECM clients at their physical locations and cater to their individual needs.
* Conduct care management activities in locations most attainable and desirable for clients.
* Have access to office space for care management activities and attend required training and meetings as needed.
* Submit mileage for field\-based care management activities for reimbursement.


Administrative Duties
  
* Write and complete all progress notes within 24 hours of service delivery.
* Write client progress letters and court reports.
* Actively participate in assigned Group Supervision, agency, and team meetings.
* Participate in training opportunities and complete assigned training in a timely manner.


And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  

QUALIFICATIONS
  
Education, Certification, or Licensure
  
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Valid First Aid and CPR certification or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire.
* Valid California driver’s license and access to registered and insured transportation.


Experience
  
* Care management experience.
* Experience working with clients experiencing acute withdrawal from substances.
* Experience working with the criminal justice population preferred.
* Experience working with Medi\-Cal, Medi\-Care, and private medical insurance plans preferred.
* Experience providing trauma\-informed services preferred.
* We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
* Must complete a background check and livescan.


HealthRIGHT 360 is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Placement within the compensation range is based on factors such as relevant experience, education, credentials, internal equity, and organizational compensation practices.

jobs.title: Child Development Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Under general supervision, provides direct service to Alameda County families providing information and linking families to services and community resources that support and/or enhance their child(ren)’s development; assesses needs and eligibility for programs/services, processes referrals and inquiries from the early childhood central access point, and manages assigned cases. Additionally, as agency and program needs evolve, additional duties may be assigned to support service delivery and departmental priorities




* Processes a high volume of referrals and inquiries received by the Help Me Grow (HMG) Phone Line/ early childhood central access point in support of early childhood development and social\-emotional well\-being.
* Contacts families via telephone to address developmental and behavioral questions or concerns and other family needs; develops child\-centered care plans, assists with understanding and supporting their child’s development, understanding available resources and services, and empowers and educates families to navigate resources and advocate for their child(ren).
* Assesses child/family needs and eligibility for programs/services; identifies appropriate referrals and coordinates referral to community resources, entitlement systems, and services that address social determinants of health; links families to other HMG components such as family navigation, and/or other agencies for family support and/or further assessment.
* Consults with service providers regarding potential referrals, developmental and behavioral concerns of children, appropriate referral pathways, and community resources available to families.
* Conducts timely follow\-up with families and providers to monitor developmental progress, ensure connection with services, and provide additional information and activities; provides feedback to referral sources of status and outcomes.
* Reviews and maintains accuracy of data of HMG Phone Line activities; analyzes data and makes recommendations for improvement; identifies systems barriers to service delivery and access and collaborates with HMG staff and partners to address barriers.
* Cultivates and maintains strong interagency relationships with community agencies/resources in order to ensure coordinated linkages to needed services.

**Minimum Qualifications**

*Any combination of training and experience that would provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities is qualifying. Additional experience and/or education can be substituted to meet typical qualifications. A typical way to obtain the required qualifications would be:*




Three (3\) years of increasingly responsible experience in child development, social service, or psychology supplemented by college level coursework or training in child development, social work, psychology, or a closely related field.




Additional relevant work experience may be substituted to meet the college coursework/bachelor's degree standard.




**Knowledge of:**

* General knowledge of child development (typical and atypical), developmental disabilities, infant and early childhood mental health, family support, and the social determinants of health.
* Principles and practices of assessment and early intervention of children birth to age five.
* Social service, health, education and developmental agencies and resources in Alameda County.
* Entitlement systems for children birth to age five and their families, including eligibility requirements.
* Outreach, interviewing, and care coordination/navigation skills and techniques.
* Strategies for effective problem\-solving and identification of systems issues.
* Applicable federal, state, and local laws, codes, and regulations as well as industry standards and best practices pertinent to the assigned area of responsibility.
* Agency and mandated safety rules, regulations, and protocols
* Techniques for providing a high level of customer service, by effectively dealing with the public, vendors, contractors, and Agency staff.
* The structure and content of the English language, including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition, and grammar.
* Modern equipment and communication tools used for business functions and program, project, and task coordination, including computers and software programs relevant to work performed.

**Ability to:**

* Use the telephone as the primary mode of communication, work effectively with and outreach to ethnically and culturally diverse families.
* Promote basic principles of health promotion and preventative health care with an understanding and acceptance of differences in attitudes toward health care and services.
* Gain confidence of and obtain personal and confidential data from clients, work with and safeguard confidential information.
* Effectively represent the department and the Agency in meetings with governmental agencies; community groups; various business, and professional organizations; and in meetings with individuals.
* Understand, interpret, and apply all pertinent laws, codes, regulations, policies and procedures, and standards relevant to work performed.
* Prepare clear and concise correspondence, documentation, and other written materials.
* Use tact, initiative, prudence, and judgment within general policy and procedural guidelines.
* Organize work, set priorities, meet critical deadlines, and follow\-up on assignments.
* Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing, using appropriate English grammar and syntax.
* Establish, maintain, and foster positive and effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.
* Effectively use computer systems, software applications relevant to work performed, and modern business equipment to perform a variety of work tasks.
* Observes and complies with all Agency and mandated safety rules, regulations, and protocols.

**Additional Requirement:**

* Bilingual proficiency is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
* United Planet
* Remote
* Full\-Time


  
**About United Planet**
-----------------------


United Planet is an international nonprofit organization headquartered in Boston, USA, dedicated to building a more peaceful, cohesive, and sustainable world through volunteer service, experiential learning, and cross\-cultural exchange. For more than 25 years, United Planet has partnered with community organizations in over 40 countries to support locally driven initiatives while fostering global understanding and cooperation.


**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Program Manager leads the development, coordination, and implementation of United Planet’s global programs with a special focus on groups. This role strategizes partner development, program budgeting, Virtual Group Quest coordination, and participant support to ensure high\-quality, mission\-aligned experiences for volunteers and host communities. The Program Manager will supervise a small team: International Groups Coordinator, Partnerships Coordinator, International Program Coordinator.


**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


Our ideal Program Manager is likely an experienced international program professional looking to level up into their first or early\-stage managerial role. While they bring hands\-on experience in global exchange, international development, or non\-profit programs, they are eager for the opportunity to step into leadership, guide a dedicated team, and build operational stability. They bring an empathetic, supportive coaching style to our growing team and excel at translating mission\-driven goals into structured, high\-impact programs. A natural mentor, they are excited to build team confidence, establish clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and empower early\-career staff to work with autonomy. Beyond internal team leadership, they are a decisive communicator and thoughtful strategist capable of managing cross\-cultural partnerships, overseeing program budgets, and ensuring rigorous safety and risk management protocols across international and virtual offerings.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Strategic Program Leadership \& Innovation**


* **Vision \& Strategy:** Define and execute a cohesive strategic vision for international and virtual programs that moves the organization from operational survival to sustainable growth and excellence.
* **Program Alignment \& Impact:** Lead overall program design and curriculum development to ensure strong alignment with United Planet’s mission and the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
* **Growth \& Optimization:** Identify market opportunities, evaluate existing program models, and drive continuous improvement across all program offerings to enhance participant outcomes and global impact.
### **Team Leadership, Empowerment \& Coaching**


* **Direct Supervision:** Lead, mentor, and supervise the program team, including the International Groups Coordinator, Partnerships Coordinator, and International Program Coordinator.
* **Team Empowerment \& Capacity Building:** Build team confidence and autonomy through clear goal setting, ongoing feedback, professional development, and supportive coaching.
* **Process \& Workflow Improvement:** Establish clear framework standard operating procedures (SOPs) and decision\-making guidelines to reduce operational insecurity and foster an environment of ownership and accountability.
### **Strategic Partnership Development \& Oversight**


* **Partnership Strategy:** Oversee the expansion and sustainability of United Planet’s global partner network, guiding the Partnerships Coordinator in target region selection and relationship management.
* **High\-Level Relationship Management:** Drive senior\-level outreach and establish strategic alliances with international partners, host organizations, and ICYE networks.
* **Vetting \& Quality Assurance:** Establish rigorous partner evaluation frameworks to assess capacity, program quality, risk, and safety considerations.
### **Financial Management \& Operational Quality**


* **Budget Strategy \& Pricing:** Develop and manage overarching program operational budgets, pricing models, and financial forecasts particularly in collaboration with the International Groups Coordinator.
* **Logistics \& Risk Management:** Refine existing protocols for participant communications, background checks, logistics, and emergency response, delegating day\-to\-day execution while retaining executive oversight.
* **Virtual Quest Leadership:** Oversee the strategy and delivery of Virtual Group Quests (VQ), ensuring seamless cross\-functional delivery between staff, host country partners, and volunteers.
**Qualifications**
------------------


### **Required**


* **Mission Alignment:** Deep passion for United Planet’s mission of global community building and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
* **Program \& Strategic Oversight:** Demonstrated understanding of scaling, designing, and evaluating international or virtual exchange programs with measurable social impact.
* **Cross\-Cultural \& Global Operations:** Hands\-on experience establishing and managing international partner relationships, navigating cross\-cultural communication, and ensuring participant safety/risk management abroad.
* **Strategic Vision \& Change Management:** Ability to step into a growing department, assess current workflows, and implement structured systems and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that build operational stability.
* **Empathetic \& Decisive Communication:** Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to provide constructive feedback, set clear expectations, and inspire confidence across a remote or hybrid team.
### **Ideal**


* Bachelor’s degree in International Relations, Non\-Profit Management, Global Studies, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.
